headword: {火|ひ}に{油|あぶら}を{注|そそ}ぐ
gloss: to add fuel to the fire

definitions.gloss: to add fuel to the fire
definitions.explanation: To make an already bad situation, especially someone's anger or a dispute, even worse.

examples.japanese: {火|ひ}に{油|あぶら}を{注|そそ}ぐな。
examples.english: Don't add fuel to the fire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}→謝罪：06754_shazai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火|ひ}に{油|あぶら}を{注|そそ}いだ。
examples.english: His apology only added fuel to the fire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{火|ひ}に{油|あぶら}を{注|そそ}ぐこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Making excuses to someone who is angry just adds fuel to the fire.

notes:
USAGE:
Often as {火|ひ}に{油|あぶら}を{注|そそ}ぐ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ or 〜こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧. Common about online backlash (⟦{炎上|えんじょう}→炎上：05867_enjou⟧) and quarrels.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧ here is read そそぐ, not つぐ. Unlike ⟦{拍車|はくしゃ}をかける→拍車をかける：31594_hakushawokakeru⟧, which speeds up a trend, this idiom is about inflaming anger or conflict.
